description: Creates or updates point-of-sale registers, matched by ItemId, then by name. Import the stock locations first.

items.description: A register: a till at one of the store's locations.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The register's name, such as the store and till it's at.

LocationId.description: The id of the stock location the register sells from.

Address.description: The store's address, with AddressLine1, City and a two-letter Country: its sales are taxed by it.

Currency.description: The three-letter currency the register sells in, or none for the store's.

Roles.description: The roles whose users can sell on the register.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the register is in use.

Registers.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
